submitted_desc: Contact your trainer if you need to update something.
thanks_desc: {{trainer}} will review this before your first session.
intro: Your trainer asked you to fill this before your first session. Takes about 10 minutes. You can come back later — we'll save your progress.
welcome_desc: {{trainer}} prepared this form to get to know you before your first session. Takes about 10 minutes. You can pause anytime — we save automatically.
identity_subtitle: Your trainer needs your name and contact. The rest is the assessment.
path_subtitle: We adapt the questions to your context.
path_coached_desc: Your coach will use this to build the plan.
path_self_desc: Forge's AI helps you turn this into training.
scheduling_subtitle: Pick the likely days. You can change later.
lifestyle_gate_title: Want to answer a few more?
lifestyle_gate_subtitle: Sleep, stress, nutrition. Helps your coach tune volume and recovery. You can skip.
review_desc: Review what you're sending. You can go back to fix anything.

sections.parq_intro: These help your trainer build a plan that's safe for you. Answer honestly — there are no wrong answers.
sections.parq_warning: Thanks for being honest. Your trainer will review these answers and may suggest a doctor's check before starting harder sessions.
sections.medication_label: Are you taking any medication regularly?
sections.medication_placeholder: e.g. blood pressure meds, insulin, painkillers…
sections.goal_what: What do you want to achieve?
sections.goal_what_placeholder: e.g. lose 5kg, run a 10k, get stronger…
sections.goal_extra: Anything else we should know about your goal?
sections.readiness_title: How ready do you feel right now?
sections.training_days: How many days a week can you train?
sections.training_duration: How long can each session be?
sections.training_conditions: Any medical conditions we should know about?
sections.training_preferences: Anything you really like or really dislike doing?
sections.lifestyle_sleep: How well do you sleep on average?
sections.lifestyle_stress: How stressed do you feel day-to-day?
sections.lifestyle_seated: How many hours do you sit per day?
sections.lifestyle_steps: Roughly how many steps do you do per day?
sections.lifestyle_energy: How is your energy through the day?
sections.lifestyle_recovery: How well do you recover from physical effort?
sections.nutrition_meals: How many meals do you eat per day?
sections.nutrition_water: How much water do you drink per day? (litres)
sections.nutrition_processed: Roughly, how often do you eat processed/fast food?
sections.nutrition_alcohol: How many alcoholic drinks per week?
sections.nutrition_habits: Anything else about how you eat — allergies, patterns, what works for you?

parq.q1: Has a doctor ever said you have a heart condition or that you should only do physical activity recommended by a doctor?
parq.q2: Do you feel pain in your chest when you do physical activity?
parq.q3: In the past month, have you had chest pain when you were not doing physical activity?
parq.q4: Do you lose your balance because of dizziness or do you ever lose consciousness?
parq.q5: Do you have a bone or joint problem that could be made worse by a change in your physical activity?
parq.q6: Is your doctor currently prescribing drugs for blood pressure or a heart condition?
parq.q7: Do you know of any other reason why you should not do physical activity?
